{{Quote|If there is a dark side to this galaxy, Socorro is on the hind side of it. Far beyond the notice of dominions large and faceless—where a man's word and the sweat of his brow are worth more than his scrip. This is truly a most splendid place to be.|[[Kirr Cyrs]]|<ref name="BSOS" />}}
'''Socorro''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] with a reputation as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] haven. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].

==Description==
[[File:Socorran_flag.png|thumb|left|80px|The Socorran flag]]
Socorro was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="OOTC" /> in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]] of the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that linked it to [[Llanic/Legends|Llanic]] and the [[Bahalian system/Legends|Bahalian system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Socorro was one of only two bodies in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="OOTC" /> and possessed no [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="LECG" /> A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Socorro lasted twenty [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 316 local days.<ref name="OOTC" />

The planet Socorro possessed a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]],<ref name="OOTC" /> an arid climate,<ref name="LECG" /> and terrain that included black [[Desert/Legends|desert]] swells, flatlands, mountain areas, and volcanic areas. Socorro's dormant volcanic basements contained naturally-hidden reserves of [[Water/Legends|water]]. The planet's surface, three-fourths of which was covered by the [[Doaba Badlands]], was composed of hardened volcanic ash. Temperatures remained at 110 degrees in the world's polar regions, where thermal winds and [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]] were common.<ref name="OOTC" />

No unifying government was present on Socorro, and control of the planet was contested by various criminal organizations.<ref name="LECG" /> A unified cultural force, resulting from integration between the planet's nomadic and criminal elements, offered formidable protection from intrusion by offworld authorities.<ref name="OOTC" /> [[Vakeyya]] was the capital of Socorro.<ref name="LECG" /> The planet exported water, [[nether ice]], and high-tech skills while importing metals and high technology. All of these transactions were typically performed in an illegal manner. Rare and peculiar modifications to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were also a major source of planetary income.<ref name="OOTC" />

Located between [[Coyn]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and near [[Duunir]], [[Iyred]], [[Omman Minor|Omman]], [[Redcap]], and the [[Nodgra system/Legends|Nodgra system]], Socorro was home to the ferocious [[M'onnok]]s, as well as several nomadic groups: the [[Ibhaan'I]], [[Bharhulai]], [[Ndowi]], and [[Asilyr]]. It was also the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]]. Its deserts were composed of distinctive black sand. The name "Socorro" in [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Old Corellian]] meant "scorched earth."

Some locations on Socorro included the [[Asilyr Tribal Lands]], the [[Bharhulai Tribal Lands]], [[Cjaalysce'I]], the Doaba Badlands, the [[Ibhaan'I Tribal Lands]], the [[Ndowi Tribal Lands]], [[Norble]], and [[Madra]]. Between the [[Rym Mountains]] and the [[City/Legends|city]] of Vakeyya was the [[Judges of the Dead]], which was considered by many [[Socorran]]s to be a shrine.

==History==
[[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] colonized the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[3000 BBY]], though only four of their original six colony ships were believed to have survived. The [[Bharhulai]] tribe was a hostile group that dwelt in Socorro's dangerous northern polar region. It was believed by the anthropologist [[Arner Figgis]] that the Bharhulai may have descended from a crashed [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] and regressed to a savage state.

One of the first beings to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the planet was [[Kirr Cyrs]]. He was also the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] of the first colony established on the planet. Kirr Cyrs was generally credited with saying that all life born on Socorro eventually [[Death/Legends|dies]] on Socorro.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Socorro was under a water supply crisis because the critical wells located around a dozen settlements in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] had gone dry. It was presumed that the wells had been sabotaged.<ref name="SeepingSuspicions">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Seeping Suspicions}}</ref> Around the same time, a renowned [[Pirate/Legends|pirate captain]] was spotted on a party at Socorro.<ref name="Party">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Pirate Partygoers}}</ref>

Socorro was the location of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Academy (Socorro)|academy]] where Jedi would train to become a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]]. It was a favorite of [[Jedi ace|Jedi Ace]] [[Crix Sunburris]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. A thousand years later, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] would use ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' to locate and destroy the academy and the Jedi who were stationed in it.<ref name="TJP" />

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
A young [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] may have met [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] on Socorro roughly a decade before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Ghost">{{Tales|11|Ghost (comic story)}}</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}

[[File:VetterTalon.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Darth Talon]] attacks [[Elke Vetter]].]]

In [[137 ABY]], Socorro was the headquarters of the [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] pirate [[Rav]]. It was there that [[Cade Skywalker]] turned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hosk Trey'lis]] over to Rav after capturing him on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. Meanwhile, [[Darth Talon]] [[Duel on Socorro|attacked]] the [[Imperial Mission]] temple on Socorro to drive [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]] to her [[Roan Fel|father]] or for him to come to her. Darth Talon killed the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Elke Vetter]] at the temple. Marasiah Fel was eventually rescued by Cade Skywalker.<ref name="Broken" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|While many scholars believe that the mettle and integrity of those early colonists expired long ago with the spirit of the early pioneers, I would argue that the same courage and fortitude that propelled them into the wilds of unknown space is very much alive and well in the sub-culture of smugglers and even more so in the culture of native Socorran pirates and the nomadic tribes of Socorro.|Arner Figgis|<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|Old Corellian: A Guide for the Curious Scholar}}</ref>}}
[[Human/Legends|Humans]] comprised ninety percent of Socorro's population,<ref name="LECG" /> which may have consisted of 300 million beings.<ref name="OOTC" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and other criminals were attracted to Socorro and established bases there. Small tribes of Humans and [[near-Human]]s who avoided civilization also lived on the world.<ref name="LECG" /> A number of nomadic tribes inhabited the Doaba Badlands,<ref name="OOTC" /> including the Bharhulai.<ref name="J7" /> Socorro was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cinda Tarheel/Legends|Cinda Tarheel]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
